key_insight: A classifier chain model can recommend pathology tests from patient symptoms with very high accuracy while accounting for dependencies between tests.
clinical_relevance: This could speed up pre-consultation test selection and support more consistent diagnostic decision-making, especially in time-sensitive settings.
method: Built a multi-label test recommendation system using Classifier Chain (CC).
Compared Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest models.
Added SHAP explanations to show which symptoms influenced each test recommendation.
evidence_signal: Using SOUTHERN.IML pathology data plus an expert-created dataset, Logistic Regression with CC achieved 98.83% overall accuracy, while a Majority Voting ensemble balanced performance with precision 0.93, recall 0.85, and F1-score 0.89.
watch_item: The approach was trained and evaluated on a specific dataset, so real-world clinical performance and generalizability should be validated before implementation.
